question: What topic begins with the description of the earthly principle?
premises: The earthly principle is the innermost of all and covered by all envelopes.
The text now turns to that earthly principle.
Within it, the arrangement of worlds is described.
inference: The cosmological survey of worlds begins from the earthly principle as the innermost level.
plain_english: That principle, standing in the innermost interval of all and covered by all the envelopes, is the earthly principle; here, within that earthly principle, the arrangement of worlds is described.
